Fields per text: id (corpus text id), source_id (corpus.sqlite sources.id), title, blurb, english_source ('site_json' = web/data/texts/<id>.json lines, 'corpus_db' = translations table, author_type='model'), model, model_version, translated_on (YYYY-MM-DD), tags [].

texts.title: Šaziga potency incantation fragment (K.8790)
texts.blurb: Neo-Assyrian fragment from Nineveh in the ŠA.ZI.GA (male potency) series: plant recipes ‘if a man’s heart does not rise for his wife’, followed by an incantation.

texts.title: Head-fever and headache remedies (Iraq 65, 222)
texts.blurb: Neo-Babylonian therapeutic recipes from Sippar: poultices for a feverish head, ear, eye, nose and tooth complaints.

texts.title: Gilgamesh, Old Babylonian Tablet II (CBS 07771)
texts.blurb: The Pennsylvania tablet of the Old Babylonian Gilgamesh epic from Nippur: Enkidu’s arrival among shepherds and the meeting with Gilgamesh.

texts.title: Royal monumental inscription (MDP 11, pl. 001-011)
texts.blurb: A long royal/monumental text published in Mémoires de la Délégation en Perse 11, machine-drafted in full.

texts.title: Liturgy (Manchester Memoirs 48, pl. 1-7)
texts.blurb: A literary liturgy published in the Manchester Memoirs; machine English for most lines.
